NVIDIA's safety strategy
articles.description: In this episode, we dive into the evolving relationship between AI and safety in the industrial world. We discuss how NVIDIA is shaping new standards for physical AI and why safety is not just a requirement, but a value driver in modern automation. You'll hear insights from Ricardo Mariani of NVIDIA on the importance of end-to-end safety frameworks, the role of simulation, and the integration of AI into robotics and machinery. We also explore the latest industry moves, from NVIDIA's acquisition of Hugging Face to trends in robotics infrastructure and global competition. Join us as we break down what it means to make AI and safety true partners in the future of industry.

Why Your Agent Evals Are Missing the Real Failures (with Aishwarya Srinivasan)
articles.description:
#AgenticAI #AIEvals #VibeCoding

In Episode #1023, Aishwarya Srinivasan (Co-Founder of The Gen Academy) joins @JonKrohnLearns to work out where a competitive moat comes from once anything you can build in ten minutes, somebody else can build in ten minutes too. Ash came to teaching through Illuminate AI, the mentorship community she started in 2020, and now trains senior engineers and leaders to ship agentic AI in production; she is blunt that vibe coding lowers the floor without touching the engineering judgment that production demands. In this episode, she explains what a whole-system eval covers that a model eval misses, traces reinforcement learning from the algorithm she patented at IBM to its resurgence in agentic fine tuning and lays out the MIND framework from her TED Talk for living with AI.

• ODSC, the Open Data Science Conference: https://odsc.ai/west/

Interested in sponsoring a SuperDataScience Podcast episode? Email natalie@superdatascience.com for sponsorship information.

In this episode you will learn:
• (00:00:00) Introduction
• (00:10:10) Why cheap code shifts the software engineering job rather than ending it
• (00:16:09) What a whole-system eval covers that a model eval misses
• (00:37:55) Why reinforcement learning came roaring back for agentic AI
• (00:43:12) The one skill Ash says matters more than any hard skill
weeks
